name: st_lrps_ablation
description: ST-LRPS ablation suite (A0..A6 cumulative progression). Secondary evidence: does not block final-candidate evidence generation. Uses the same dataset split, train-only scaler, and seed across ablations.

dataset.train_data: <FILL: residual cloud HDF5 (same dataset as final candidates)>

note: matrix='default' runs A0..A6; 'all' adds optional A7/A8/A9 encodings. Set execute=true to launch training; default is dry-run (commands + manifest only). Ablation is expensive and optional.
